# H3Act offline evidence pipeline

Run `python3 -B main.py` with a single JSON document on stdin (no arguments) and
read a single JSON document from stdout.  Pydantic and its pinned dependencies
are preinstalled; no network, model, certificate or service configuration is
needed.  See `../PROTOCOL.md` and `../RUNTIME.md` for the complete contract.

## Layout

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `main.py` | CLI: strict input validation, budgets, template compilation, orchestration |
| `schema.py` | Typed payload models; frames become byte sequences through the context |
| `modules/byte_program.py` | Compressed byte sequences, expressions, templates, fingerprints |
| `modules/fuzz_adapter.py` | FuzzExecutor: frame conversion and client receipts |
| `HTTP3_Just_Send.py` | `HttpClient` request/response lifecycle over the injected transport |
| `modules/clock.py` | Socket-free coroutine clock with the published same-time ordering |
| `modules/events.py` | Decoded event records and `SendError` |
| `modules/capture_audit.py` | HTTP/1.1 capture framing, provenance and evidence flags |

## Notes on the repair

* Byte sequences are never expanded eagerly.  A sequence is an expression tree
  (`Lit`/`Cat`/`Rep`/`Cut`); lengths and the `sum((b[i]+1)*257**(n-1-i))`
  fingerprint are derived algebraically, so a `10**12` byte capture costs a few
  integers.  Only bounded windows (at most a line plus its terminator) are
  materialised while framing a capture, and small captures are expanded once for
  speed and released again afterwards.
* Definition expressions are parsed with `ast.parse(source, mode="eval")` and
  walked with the documented depth rule (every AST child edge counts, including
  operator and context nodes; parentheses do not).
* Templates: a string starting `{{` and ending `}}` is an expression after
  stripping; otherwise it is UTF-8 literal data whose `<<random_string>>`
  occurrences are replaced by `sha256(seed/coordinate/occurrence)` prefix hex.
* The replay completes a request whose response end was retained *while it was
  still sending or paused* instead of waiting for a waiter that can no longer be
  woken, and it never emits a frame after the send side closed.
* Capture parsing follows the published line/block limits, Content-Length comma
  lists, single `chunked` Transfer-Encoding, trailer rules, and the
  request/chunk-line budgets; provenance merges equal owner labels in order of
  first occurrence.

Diagnostic flags describe this paired recording; they are not a proof of any
real vulnerability and no traffic is sent.
EOF
